testing_evidence.evidence: Dedicated model/config/packet tests plus real loopback UDP reflector DV cover zero, one, duplicate, malformed, two and three-port behavior, fixed tokens, complete endpoints, timeout Unknown, and same-socket stable observation; sn-miner parsing and service validation are independently exercised.

A real in-process SN with two probe ports and two cold clients proves the first SnQueryResp carries the callee profile, query_with_context returns the same-SN caller profile, and the exact ordered context reaches SnCalled; an empty-local-cache serving-lease query reaches the remote SnService detail boundary through an explicitly constructor-injected Inter-SN client fake and final SnQueryResp; per-ActiveSN isolation, profile expiry, ReportSn/SnCalled malformed tails, and additive wire tests cover ownership and compatibility without a remote profile cache or singleton fallback.

The pure selector test covers ordered NonSymmetricLike/NonSymmetricLike, NonSymmetricLike/SymmetricLike, SymmetricLike/NonSymmetricLike, SymmetricLike/SymmetricLike, both Public orientations, Unknown, and unpredictable symmetric bounded-best-effort actions for caller and callee.

Profile tests cover consistent and irregular deltas, parity, IP mismatch, expiry, overflow and the eight-port cap; TunnelManager applies hints only to current non-LAN IPv4 QUIC ServerReflexive bases, executes a predicted candidate success, and proves all predicted misses converge to PN.

Direction-aware waiter tests cover active match and wrong-direction preservation; a five-second delayed call future proves action success returns within 250ms and cancels the call owner; predicted all-miss and generic action failure reach PN; incoming success, owner-drop, deadline, duration overflow, and listener close stop PunchOnly; the full 56-test TunnelManager regression retains legacy, reverse, proxy and duplicate behavior.

return_records.reason: A cold current-rendezvous profile was originally modeled as arriving in SnCallResp, conflicting with the required immediate Unknown timeline.
return_records.resolution: The user clarified that SnQueryResp returns net_profile. The revised design passes that one-shot peer result to TunnelManager, freezes both snapshots in SnCall.nat_context, forwards it unchanged as SnCalled.nat_context, never uses SnCallResp as a profile source or plan gate, and immediately runs the legacy path when the query field is absent.

return_records.reason: The first testing scope audit found that the production call/action concurrency helper and new-file cfg(test) seams were added after the implementation boundary, so the testing-stage baseline could not prove a test-only delta.
return_records.resolution: The helper and test seams are now owned by their already admitted production paths; implementation scope and the three-crate compile closure pass. Testing restarts from that validated implementation state and claims only dedicated test artifacts and evidence.

return_records.reason: Acceptance found an advertised-IP override outside identity evidence, detached callee action ownership, and prediction applied to non-ServerReflexive bases.
return_records.resolution: Removed the public IP override, derived probe advertisement only from identity static-WAN endpoints, preserved sn-miner wildcard binding with mapped endpoint pairs, awaited SnCalled handling without detached spawn, restricted prediction to ServerReflexive non-LAN bases, and revalidated implementation scope and compilation.

return_records.reason: Acceptance found missing runnable evidence for NAT-aware actions, PN fallback, cancellation/races, per-SN isolation, distributed response forwarding, and peer-profile expiry.
return_records.resolution: The fresh 18-step task run adds runnable evidence for PN fallback under simultaneous action/call failure, eligible prediction bases, PunchOnly incoming-success and owner-drop cancellation, per-ActiveSN isolation, distributed detail forwarding without replication, and independent peer-profile expiry; all steps exit zero and testing coverage and scope pass.

return_records.reason: Second acceptance verified all implementation defects closed but found no executed predicted hit/all-miss-to-PN path, PunchOnly deadline step, full cold distributed query chain, ReportSn request compatibility, or malformed/unknown SnCalled context tail.
return_records.resolution: The 20-step task artifact now executes predicted hit, all-predicted miss to PN, PunchOnly deadline and duration overflow, cold distributed final SnQueryResp, ReportSn request compatibility, and malformed/unknown SnCalled tails; every step exits zero and coverage/scope checks pass.

return_records.reason: The second testing scope check rejected the cfg(test) registry resolver added inside the production distributed-query method even though release behavior is unchanged.
return_records.resolution: The release-disabled registry resolver is now owned by the admitted service implementation path; the three-crate compile closure and 21-path implementation scope pass, and testing restored only the inline test from a new baseline.

return_records.reason: Third acceptance found that the cfg(test) InterSnRegistry fallback violates the approved distributed-directory no-singleton contract and bypasses the production client abstraction.
return_records.resolution: SnService now owns an internal Inter-SN client trait with a production TtpInterSnClient adapter and a test-only constructor for explicit fake injection; the implicit registry fallback and registration were removed, targeted static search is empty, and implementation compile/scope pass.
